blocks.heading: Energy and Nuclear Research (Oak Ridge National Laboratory's Commercial Ecosystem)
paragraphs: Oak Ridge National Laboratory — managed by UT-Battelle for the DOE, with 5,000+ researchers — is one of the world's leading science laboratories. Its commercial ecosystem creates technology AI demand:

Materials science analytics: ML for materials property prediction and characterization from experimental data — applicable to Knoxville's materials science startup and supplier community adjacent to ORNL's research programs.
Scientific computing optimization: ML for computational workflow optimization at Knoxville's high-performance computing community.

Energy systems analytics: Grid analytics and energy efficiency AI for Tennessee's energy infrastructure — TVA (Tennessee Valley Authority, Knoxville HQ area) is a major regional utility with specific grid AI requirements.

Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA): TVA's nuclear fleet (Browns Ferry, Sequoyah, Watts Bar) and hydroelectric operations create grid analytics and nuclear facility operations AI demand. ClickMasters builds commercial AI for TVA's non-nuclear-safety business operations.
Classified and nuclear-safety-critical technical work is outside ClickMasters' scope.
Cost: $30,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks

blocks.heading: Manufacturing
paragraphs: Knoxville's manufacturing base — automotive suppliers (Toyota has a major presence in the broader Tennessee market), glass manufacturing (Rexnord, Owens Corning operations), plastics, and food processing:
Automotive component quality inspection AI for Knoxville's Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier community.
Predictive maintenance from manufacturing equipment sensor data.
Supply chain disruption prediction for Knoxville's manufacturing supply chains.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Covenant Health (Knoxville HQ, East Tennessee's largest healthcare network) and University of Tennessee Medical Center. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Knoxville's health systems.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Logistics and Distribution
paragraphs: Knoxville's position at the I-40/I-75 interchange — connecting the East-West and North-South interstate corridors — makes it a regional distribution hub for the Southeast:
Warehouse operations AI for Knoxville's distribution centers.
Last-mile route optimization for East Tennessee's geography.
Supply chain analytics for Knoxville's distribution community.
Cost: $35,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks
